title: spot breakdown by eye
system_instruction_addendum: SPOT BREAKDOWN EYE ADDENDUM: The breakdown on the waveform is a thinner section: less low end, taller mids. Point to the waveform, not the audio.

tutor_speak.text: the breakdown shows up on the waveform as a thin section: the low end thins out, the mids carry alone.
scan the waveform on deck A. tap continue when your cursor sits inside the thin section.

hints.text: the kick draws the tallest bars on the waveform: find where they shrink.
the breakdown often shows up as a stripe of skinny waveform.
tap continue when you've spotted the thin section.
